name: radica
description: A 100% decentralized social media platform powered by Freenet

scripts.build:contract: cargo build --manifest-path contract/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && cargo build --manifest-path log-contract/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && cargo build --manifest-path media-contract/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && cargo build --manifest-path river-wasm/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release
scripts.build: npm run build:contract && npm run build:ui
scripts.freenet:publish: npm run freenet:build && node ui/scripts/split-freenet-dist.mjs app && fdev website publish ui/dist-app --key radica
scripts.freenet:update: npm run freenet:build && node ui/scripts/split-freenet-dist.mjs app && fdev website update ui/dist-app --key radica
scripts.freenet:assets:publish: npm run freenet:build && node ui/scripts/split-freenet-dist.mjs assets && fdev website publish ui/dist-assets --key radica-assets
scripts.freenet:assets:update: npm run freenet:build && node ui/scripts/split-freenet-dist.mjs assets && fdev website update ui/dist-assets --key radica-assets
scripts.test: npm run test:ui && npm run test:contract
scripts.test:contract: cargo test --manifest-path contract/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path log-contract/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path delegate/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path river-wasm/Cargo.toml

author: Radica Community
